key_terms.مَرْفُوعَةٍ: Exalted, elevated in rank or status
key_terms.مُطَهَّرَةٍ: Purified, free from impurity or error

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for the Quran to be 'exalted and holy'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the *isma* (infallibility) and divine preservation of the Quran, affirming it as the uncorrupted word of Allah free from human alteration. It serves as a foundational proof for the Quran's authenticity and its role as the ultimate source of guidance, distinct from other scriptures that may have undergone textual changes.
